hero.headline: Every Night, Just Me
hero.subheadline: A postpartum night-coordination system that replaces nightly arguing with a pre-agreed roster, a fairness ledger, and the exact words to make it stick.
hero.body: You are running every night alone while your partner sleeps. Nobody owns the night, so the default becomes you own all of it. This system makes the division explicit: a written roster, three templates, a sleep banker, and the scripts to make it stick.
hero.trust_line: Educational content - not medical, clinical, or mental-health advice. This coordinates night-care between adults; it never diagnoses or treats any condition and never replaces professional care.
hero.evidence_label: Educational content informed by relationship research, postpartum guidance, and lived experience. It is not a substitute for medical, clinical, or mental-health assessment.

before_state.label: Before
before_state.headline: The night has no owner
paragraphs: Doing 100% of nights, every night, for weeks.
'Can you help more?' produced a one-off gesture, not a system.
Rage at his calm breathing while you feed; grief for the relationship.
before_state.punch: This is not a character flaw. It is a system gap - and the roster closes it.

ticks.text: You wake for every feed - alone
He doesn't know what help looks like
The score is kept in your head

before_after.label: Before / After
before_after.headline: From she-does-everything to an agreement
before_after.intro: The change is observable, not a feeling.
before_items: Nights/week with zero protected block: all of them
Arguments about 'whose turn' several times a week
after_items: A protected block >=3h on most nights
Partner initiates his shift without being reminded

who_for.label: Who it's for
who_for.headline: Built for the mother running every night alone
who_for.intro: Read the not-for list as carefully as the for list.
for_items: You are 0-12 weeks postpartum and doing 100% of nights
Your partner is present but 'helping' means one nappy change
You are breastfeeding and believed you had no choice but to do it all
You have no partner at home and need a support-web roster
not_for_items: Baby sleep training or a newborn sleep program
A diagnosis or treatment for postpartum depression or any condition
A guarantee that every night will work
who_for.note: When exhaustion stops being 'tired', this system stops and routes out to professional care.

promise.label: What we promise - and what we don't
promise.headline: A written agreement, not a guarantee.
promise.we_do: A written, fair night-shift system both adults follow, protecting a 4-5 hour sleep opportunity for the mother whenever circumstances allow - without renegotiating it every night.
promise.we_do_not: We do not promise sleep (a newborn still wakes), a cure for exhaustion, a mental-health or relationship outcome, or that any single night will go to plan. This is a coordination system, not medical care.
promise.evidence_label: Educational content informed by relationship research, postpartum guidance, and lived experience. It is not a substitute for medical, clinical, or mental-health assessment.
